# InnStack

> Guides and browser-based calculators for independent hospitality operators.

## Guides
- [All guides](https://innstack.online/guides/): Hotel operations, distribution and reporting.
- [PMS vs channel manager vs booking engine](https://innstack.online/guides/pms-vs-channel-manager-vs-booking-engine/): Understand the three software roles.
- [Rate parity and direct pricing](https://innstack.online/guides/hotel-rate-parity-direct-booking-pricing/): Pricing conditions, channel costs and illustrative examples.
- [Prevent double bookings](https://innstack.online/guides/prevent-double-bookings-airbnb-booking-com/): Inventory synchronization and setup checks.

## Calculators
- [All calculators](https://innstack.online/tools/): OTA commission, direct-booking savings, occupancy, ADR and RevPAR.
- [RevPAR calculator](https://innstack.online/revpar-calculator/): Formulas, worked examples and limitations.

## About the publication
- [Software categories](https://innstack.online/software/): Workflow-based evaluation questions; researched profiles are added when available.
- [Methodology](https://innstack.online/methodology/): Editorial and evaluation approach.
